# Chapter 1: The Paper Map

## Scene 1: Morning inventory

Day 1 began with the blue tool case on the wrong side of the desk at the Night Bus depot, which was how I knew the plan had already changed. Jon Bell arrived carrying a paper cup and a list of three jobs, while Tavi North stood by the door counting cables that belonged to no case we could find. Nobody raised a voice; the loudest thing in the room was rain ticking on sheet metal, repeating itself whenever the conversation paused.

I wrote the new route in the margin, crossed out the clever shortcut, and asked each person to name the task they could actually finish before lunch. The answer was smaller than our original ambition but more useful: return one borrowed item, repair one label, and leave the next shift a note that did not pretend everything had worked.

By late afternoon the mistake had become ordinary enough to examine, and we agreed that a late arrival can still be honest if the delay is named before the door opens. I closed the entry with the time, the place, and the name of the person holding the key, because memory is generous but a handover should be exact.

Nobody raised a voice; the loudest thing in the room was a loose vent clicking, repeating itself whenever the conversation paused.

The answer was smaller than our original ambition but more useful: return one borrowed item, repair one label, and leave the next shift a note that did not pretend everything had worked.
